content_units: This schedule fits all required sessions inside the allowed windows, respects the   no starts before 09:30   rule, and keeps the   budget review after the kickoff  .
09:30 AM-11:00 AM   90 min   Project Kickoff   Starts at the earliest allowed time
11:00 AM-11:15 AM   15 min   Break 1   Buffer before the morning window ends
01:00 PM-01:45 PM   45 min   Budget Review   Happens after kickoff, as required
01:45 PM-02:00 PM   15 min   Break 2   Natural pause after review
-   All meetings start at or after 09:30 AM
-   Budget review is after the kickoff
- Budget review begins later in the afternoon.
-   Everything fits inside the available windows
- One break immediately after the kickoff
- One break immediately after the budget review
- The longest session is placed first, when energy is highest.
- The review is separated into the afternoon, which helps the team reset and return focused.
- There is still extra unused buffer time in both windows in case the discussion runs long.
- Total usable availability after the 09:30 rule:
You are using only   165 of 330 minutes  , so the plan is comfortably feasible.
- Morning window starts at 09:00 AM, but the first valid meeting start is   09:30 AM   due to the constraint.
- Breaks were treated as scheduled blocks within the day, not just informal gaps.
